chansons.style: Deep house, four on the floor, warm analog bassline, chopped vocal hooks, soulful male vocal, nostalgic and emotional vibe, 120 BPM
chansons.resume_fr: Un voyageur retrouve enfin la paix en revenant dans sa région d'origine après des années d'errance.
chansons.paroles:
[Intro]
Ooh, coming back.

[Verse 1]
I packed my bags a thousand days ago
Chasing lights in cities I don't know
The neon signs they never felt like home
I spent my youth but I was all alone
Now the highway stretches out before my eyes
Underneath the fading evening skies

[Pre-Chorus]
Every mile is bringing me closer
To the place where my heart is supposed to be
Every turn is making it clearer

[Chorus]
I'm coming back to where I belong
Back to the roots, back to the song
Feet on the ground, I'm finally home
No more wandering, no more to roam
I'm coming back, yeah I'm coming back

[Verse 2]
The old oak tree is standing by the gate
I see the porch, I know I'm not too late
The dusty road remembers every step
The memories I thought I had forgot
Now the porch light is shining in the dark

[Chorus]
I'm coming back to where I belong
Back to the roots, back to the song
Feet on the ground, I'm finally home
No more wandering, no more to roam
I'm coming back, yeah I'm coming back

[Bridge]
Take me home, take me home
Where the river flows and the wild winds blow
Take me home, take me home

[Chorus]
I'm coming back to where I belong
Back to the roots, back to the song
Feet on the ground, I'm finally home
No more wandering, no more to roam
I'm coming back, yeah I'm coming back

[Outro]
I'm home.
Yeah, I'm home.

The road ahead is open and so wide

[Chorus]
This is a new beginning, a brand new day
Washing all the dusty yesterday away
I'm stepping out, I'm finally moving on
The darkest night is over, I have won

chansons.paroles:
[Intro]
Concrete streets, familiar beats.

[Verse 1]
The corner store is still upon the block
I hear the distant ticking of the clock
The graffiti on the alleyway remains
A painted picture of my childhood veins
I know the cracks upon the pavement stone
This is the only kingdom I have known

[Pre-Chorus]
Every corner holds a memory
Of the person that I used to be

[Chorus]
Oh, my hometown, you're in my blood
Rising like a river in the flood
You're the rhythm that my heartbeat makes
Through the triumphs and the heartaches
Hometown, you will never fade away

[Verse 2]
The playground swings are rusting in the park
We used to stay out talking in the dark
The streetlights flicker like they did back then
I'd give my soul to be a kid again
But time moves on and people drift apart
You'll always be the center of my heart

[Chorus]
Oh, my hometown, you're in my blood
Rising like a river in the flood
You're the rhythm that my heartbeat makes
Through the triumphs and the heartaches
Hometown, you will never fade away

[Bridge]
Roots run deep beneath the soil
Through the hustle and the toil
I am yours, I am yours

[Chorus]
Oh, my hometown, you're in my blood
Rising like a river in the flood
You're the rhythm that my heartbeat makes
Through the triumphs and the heartaches
Hometown, you will never fade away

[Outro]
Never fade away.
My hometown.

We talked until the stars came out to play

[Pre-Chorus]

[Chorus]

The beautiful emotion deep inside

[Verse 2]
We walked along the pier beneath the moon
I swore to you I'd see you very soon
Your laughter was a song I memorized
The universe was reflecting in your eyes
Though seasons change and years have slipped away
The feeling of your hand with me will stay

[Chorus]
My first love, sweet and innocent
Every single second heaven sent
You were the melody I couldn't hide
The beautiful emotion deep inside
First love, you're forever in my mind

[Bridge]
Oh, the sweetness of the start
You're the keeper of my heart

[Chorus]
My first love, sweet and innocent
Every single second heaven sent
You were the melody I couldn't hide
The beautiful emotion deep inside
First love, you're forever in my mind

[Outro]
In my mind.
First love.

chansons.style: Dark deep house, haunting minor chords, echoing vocal chops, deep sub bass, melancholic and moody late night atmosphere, 121 BPM
chansons.resume_fr: La douleur sourde de l'éloignement et la nostalgie cuisante d'un exilé qui rêve de sa terre natale.
chansons.paroles:
[Intro]
Far away, cold and gray.
Wishing I was there today.

[Verse 1]
The foreign streets are busy and so loud
But I am just a ghost inside the crowd
The language on the signs I cannot read
I miss the simple comfort that I need
I look up at the moon and wonder why
It doesn't look the same in this new sky

[Pre-Chorus]
A heavy ache is sitting in my bones
Surrounded by a million cold unknowns

[Chorus]
Exile is a lonely, bitter pill
My homesick heart is aching, standing still
I close my eyes and I am back again
With all my family and my closest friends
Oh, the exile hurts, the distance is so deep

[Verse 2]
I cook the meals my mother used to make
But nothing tastes the same, it's a mistake
I play the old songs on my radio
And let the tears of nostalgia flow
Building up a life upon this shore
But my soul knocks on my homeland's door

[Chorus]
Exile is a lonely, bitter pill
My homesick heart is aching, standing still
I close my eyes and I am back again
With all my family and my closest friends
Oh, the exile hurts, the distance is so deep

[Bridge]
Take me back across the sea
To the place where I am free
I am longing, I am yearning

[Chorus]
Exile is a lonely, bitter pill
My homesick heart is aching, standing still
I close my eyes and I am back again
With all my family and my closest friends
Oh, the exile hurts, the distance is so deep

[Outro]
So deep.
Take me home.

Watching all the shadows pass.

[Chorus]

Oh silver rain, come wash my cares away

Your melody is soft upon the roof

[Chorus]
Oh silver rain, come wash my cares away
Turn the blackest night into the gray
Your melody is soft upon the roof
Nature's tender, undeniable proof
